blurb: Guests do tandem skydiving jumps from 13,000 or 18,000 feet with freefall and parachute descent, including pre-jump training and optional video/photo packages. They also offer Accelerated Free Fall (AFF) courses with multiple levels for learning to skydive solo. The facility operates year-round and provides all necessary equipment for jumps.
